purpose: Identify known overlapping write resources before independent capability scheduling. This inventory is deliberately fail-closed and is not an execution authorization.

evidence_scope.limitation: Static ownership classification only. Production intermediates are confined to RUNNER_TEMP; the publish path stages and commits rulesets/** only. Watchdog and scheduler state mutations use their dedicated GitHub control-plane operations. This inventory does not claim per-write filesystem interception.
evidence_scope.validation_status: Implementation cleanup recorded; acceptance is the next phase.

modules/uu.conf.enforcement_evidence: task_scheduler protected-config digest guard and auto_sync publish-job pre/post staging checks
modules/uu.conf.scheduling_rule: Any detected modification must fail closed; no capability may claim write ownership.

resource_groups.note: Source activation changes exist only in the isolated production workspace and do not update the repository source registry.
Candidate observations and buffers are run-local intermediate data, never a persistent repository ledger.

The durable queue is control-plane state, not a production resource lease. GitHubContentsQueueStore requires the exact current Blob SHA for every update and retries only explicit SHA conflicts; the complete candidate queue is independently validated before and after mutation. Manual authorization is consumed once per Watchdog run ID and stored atomically with the exact task ID, target, idempotency key, fingerprint, and trusted run scope. Local task_queue_runtime is runner-local flock/atomic replace only, not a cross-runner shared writer. script_resource_lease_runtime also mutates the queue's lease records through the same SHA-CAS store; it is a control-plane lease writer, not a direct production-resource writer.

lifecycle_gate.py writes milestone/monthly review state directly. The current auto_sync call is protected by the central production-pipeline fence; no separate per-resource lease assertion exists in the script. Allowlisted publish-mode restore is an additional writer and is serialized by the same auto_sync logical production-pipeline fence.

The validator recovers owner-approved modules/uu.conf identity into its local workspace only. The workflow has contents:read and cannot publish these metadata changes; modules/uu.conf itself is read-only.
Policy-source overlap evidence is an intermediate audit output stored only in RUNNER_TEMP.
All three entrypoints can affect published policy lists; serialize them until a single-writer ownership boundary is enforced.
Production reports and dashboard snapshots are generated in per-run workspaces. The ruleset publisher does not restore or commit report/dashboard paths.
The intake workflow validates the hostname batch in RUNNER_TEMP and forwards it as a Watchdog task input. It has contents:read and does not create or update a repository observation ledger.
resource_groups.notes: Request intake validates hostnames in RUNNER_TEMP and forwards the immutable batch as a Watchdog task input. It has contents:read only and performs no repository ledger writes.

resource_groups.note: The review cursor is a local checkpoint within the isolated production workspace. No persistent artifact upload, restore helper, Git stage or repository commit exists.
resource_groups.notes: Review cursor helpers write only inside the isolated RUNNER_TEMP production workspace. No workflow artifact upload, repository restore, stage or commit is permitted.

resource_groups.note: Rule provenance is generated for the current audit only; it is excluded from artifact and Git publication.
Manifest reconciliation and production/lifecycle/conflict flows share this resource.
Exact per-file writer coverage and indirect writes still require call-graph tracing.
The repair script modifies only one of two hard-coded paths, then the workflow stages exactly the selected path and publishes a run-specific PR branch. No direct main write is performed.

paths: path-selected JSON documents and their adjacent .manifest.json / shard files
resource_groups.note: The JSON document store performs atomic local writes without per-file lease assertions. Production callers run inside RUNNER_TEMP; control-plane writers use their own CAS store.

Assessment history, runtime fingerprints and report are local intermediate files in RUNNER_TEMP. The independent assessment adapter is disabled; none is included in the audit artifact or publisher allowlist.
resource_groups.notes: The independent assessment adapter is disabled. Any assessment executed in the monolithic audit runs in RUNNER_TEMP and is never published as repository state.

resource_groups.note: Source candidate matrix and report are intermediate outputs in RUNNER_TEMP, not part of the rulesets-only artifact.
Discovery inventory and report are produced inside the current workflow's RUNNER_TEMP workspace. Both workflows leave these paths out of repository publication.
resource_groups.notes: Discovery inventory and report are produced only in RUNNER_TEMP and uploaded as a run-scoped immutable artifact; no repository write or per-file filesystem lease hook.

resource_groups.note: Watchdog now re-reads the current Blob SHA and re-merges the same run-scoped paths on each of up to three conditional Contents API PUT attempts. observed_run_ids makes retries idempotent when another run updates the path between attempts. Conflicts after the third attempt fail closed. Distinct runs remain concurrent; parallel-run integration/no-lost-update proof is outstanding.

required_before_enablement: CI and complete deterministic test suite pass for the capability.
The scheduler atomically acquires the shared production mutex and all declared output leases.
The child re-reads live queue state and checks the exact active fencing token at every filesystem mutation boundary.
The independent verifier accepts only matching runtime/persistent/report artifacts.
A controlled post-merge scheduler canary passes without changing modules/uu.conf.

enforcement: auto_sync copies the checkout into RUNNER_TEMP and runs production commands from that isolated copy
the audit artifact packages rulesets/** only
restore_automation_state.py rejects every archive member outside rulesets/** before restoring
the publish job stages rulesets/** only and rejects every staged path outside rulesets/**
No filesystem write guard or per-write audit hook is installed.
